options.name: Adventure Courses
options.detail: Three levels of obstacles with increasing difficulty, plus an Extreme Course add-on and a Kids Course for ages 5-12.

options.name: Extreme Course
options.detail: Add-on to Classic Course with highest and most challenging obstacles up to 60ft high.

options.name: Kids Course
options.detail: Single-level course up to 15 feet high for kids aged 5 to 12.

options.name: Bungy Jump
options.detail: 150ft jump over the Nanaimo River with sixteen jump styles in six difficulty levels.

options.name: Primal Swing
options.detail: 140km/h swing fling over 150ft into long arcs over the Nanaimo River canyon.

options.name: Zipline Tour
options.detail: Two open-air ziplines over 90 feet above the Nanaimo River Canyon, 300ft and 600ft lines.

options.name: Axe Throwing
options.detail: Throw a razor-sharp axe into a wooden target at the end of a 14ft alley.

options.name: What's To Fear Jump
options.detail: 40ft plunge jump from a wooden platform secured to a jump line.

options.name: Caves & Canopies Bundle
options.detail: Classic Adventure Course plus Horne Lake Caves Action Pack Tour. Minimum height 4’8", ages 8+.

blurb: Guests can experience a 150ft bungy jump, a 140km/h Primal Swing, canyon ziplines, treetop adventure courses with multiple levels, and axe throwing. The park is set on the Nanaimo River and offers activities suitable for thrill-seekers, families, and groups. Several bundles combine multiple activities for longer experiences.
